主要内容: Insperity, Inc. announced the approval of its 2012 Incentive Plan during a shareholder meeting on May 17, 2012. The plan received 16,873,734 votes in favor, 5,333,251 against, and 5,917 abstentions. Additionally, the company received 1,564,379 broker non-votes. The vote was part of the company's annual shareholder meeting, where other proposals, including executive compensation and auditor ratification, were also considered.
